title: Higher direct images along a morphism from an integral normal scheme with separably closed function field vanish
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the higher direct images of a constant abelian sheaf along a morphism from an integral normal scheme with separably closed function field all vanish (statement lines 14368-14373). The proof (proof lines 14375-14387) describes the higher direct images as sheafified cohomology over the base change, splits the base change for affine V into open subschemes of X using the structure lemma, and concludes by the equality of etale and Zariski cohomology and the vanishing of the cohomology of a constant sheaf on an irreducible space. H2: one description plus one vanishing input.
